name: Bespoke-Stratos-7B
notes: The 17k-step version of the Bespoke-Stratos RL-on-Sky-T1-Reasoning line; architecture is Qwen2.5-7B's, unchanged (Qwen2ForCausalLM, hidden 3584, 28 layers, 28 query heads / 4 KV heads, 32768 context). Its 32B sibling Sky-T1-32B-Preview is the same Qwen2.5-32B shape as DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B, so the two families are drop-in interchangeable from a serving standpoint. head_dim derived as 3584 / 28 = 128.KV bytes/token at bf16 (2 bytes/element): 28 layers x 4 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 bytes = 57344 B/token = 56.0 KiB/token. context_scaling is null: context length is native to the pretrained config, no rope_scaling.
